method: Manual semantic grading; a bit is 1 only when every criterion conjunct is explicit. No partial credit or inference of omitted owners, limits, dates, caveats, actions, or semantic roles.

revision.reason: The Keep result gives an action but no explicit next owner, and global leadership/accountability text cannot be inferred into each result under the criterion's every-result owner/action conjunct.

integrity.blind_read_boundary: The scorer opened only rubric.json, generation-plan.json, generation-attestation.json, skill-freeze.json, the ten attested responses, and the scorer's own ignored audit. SKILL.md and runtime-contract.md hashes are declarations reproduced from skill-freeze.json; those targets were not opened.
